description: On the surface in front of you there’s a tall dark cup, a small toothpaste tube with its cap nearby, and a purple toothbrush. The right hand lifts the toothbrush from near the cup and hovers it in front of the left hand, while the left hand picks up and orients the toothpaste tube over the toothbrush head, then squeezes a small line of paste onto the bristles and pulls the tube back as the right hand keeps the brush steady.
